target.name: PreyVR source da1ad4e8355fb4ef3851bd5a7ce3f10e74d72173; Steam PreyDll.dll UI static leads

question: Does automatic equip-time wrist rotation capture preserve an arbitrary controller/native-wrist mismatch, and what contract removes it?
claim: CalibrationState requeues completed hand calibration after equip/reference/tracking changes. DriveHand captures inverse(controllerModel)*animatedWrist, preserving any initial mismatch instead of aligning the barrel with the independently computed aim-pose ray. The compiled pinned-source fixture preserves a 45-degree mismatch both at capture and after return to neutral. A full authored barrel/mount basis solve closes algebraically across synthetic assets and noncommuting pose/root rotations. Independent HUD sizing remains an unimplemented movie-subelement contract, not an established existing control.
method: Read pinned source and existing R-118/F-017 UI evidence; compile EquipAlignmentAudit.cpp against exact source snapshots with MSVC 19.50.35729.0 and CMake Visual Studio 18 2026 in build/equip-alignment-audit. Run the executable (exact commands/output in verification.txt). Read-only Ghidra program info/options/string searches/decompiles and schema-documented local GET xrefs inspect /Prey/PreyDll.dll; imported SHA matches disk 7d6e322f61b28331095a400f0ba5f09bd9a39c57bf993602285dd6acb05311a7. No native calls or runtime tests performed.

instrument.reason: Compiled actual project calibration math/lifecycle reproduces observed-class dependency; native UI results retained as static leads only.

control.reason: Identity wrist and 45-degree capture sweep demonstrate retained mismatch; 2 synthetic asset mappings across 16 noncommuting pose/root cases close proposed barrel orientation; mathematical design control is not a Prey asset acceptance result.

scene.reason: Static source and offline harness; no new game observation.

restore.reason: No game process, runtime configuration, native binary or production behavior changed.

baseline.reason: No shipped correction or runtime/headset acceptance; isolated harness build passed.

limits: The fixture proves the calibration dependency, not the exact wearer angle or absence of downstream animation. Authored Prey weapon/barrel bases were not recovered here. UI size implementation requires actual movie object paths and verified scale ownership/API; defined DLL string search is not exhaustive ActionScript coverage. Standard ZIP checks did not decode GameData/Scripts PAK assets. Prior F-017 runtime observations are attributed, not remeasured.
